caption:
Stop copying numbers from invoices and client quotes into blank sheets. Gemini 4 Neon reads those files and outputs a clean table you can paste straight into your accounting software. It handles standard PDFs and CSV exports without manual formatting.

Open the Gemini app and select Gemini 4 Neon. Upload one messy file and paste this exact prompt:
"Extract all line items, dates, and amounts from this file. Output a plain text table with columns for Date, Description, and Total. Skip headers and footers. Flag any unreadable sections."


This runs on Google AI Pro or Ultra plans. The API tier costs $3 per million input tokens, making it cheap for daily admin work. 

Save this for later when you face a stack of unorganized files.

body.t: Gemini 4 Neon is a computer system that reads and organizes written information.
Gemini 4 Neon turns messy spreadsheets and PDF files into clean data, like listing client expenses.
Only Google AI Pro or Ultra subscribers, paid plans for AI services, can use Gemini 4 Neon.
